I just wanted to drop an update here. That game isn't dead and has entered a closed beta with completely reworked gameplay.  The game received a lot of great feedback from the 2024 Next Fest.  The current plan is to go into Early Access in early 2026.  So keep an eye here! And please Wishlist the game if you haven't already! See you soon![/p]
